profile.name: NI-DAQ任务等待线程
profile.description: 用于实验控制流程中的非物理软件组件。它以线程方式连接任务对象、运行等待逻辑并执行关闭操作，适合配合 NI-DAQ 相关任务的异步执行与生命周期管理。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component used in laboratory control workflows. It runs as a thread to attach to a task object, execute waiting logic, and handle closure, supporting asynchronous execution and lifecycle management of NI-DAQ-related tasks.

registry.name: For interaction with NI-DAQ hardware interfaces
registry.description: Wait Thread是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、关闭、启动、扫描、日志记录、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, inputTaskDone等操作。
